label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled input 'param' obtained via request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') on line 18 flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) on line 22 without sanitization. The conditional check on the Referer header does not validate the destination path contained in 'param', allowing an attacker to specify arbitrary redirect destinations (vulnerable to open redirect or path traversal).

evidence.note: User input 'param' sourced from request.getParameter flows directly to sendRedirect sink without validation.
